notes.title: Patch note(June 4th 2025)
notes.notes:
This patch includes below bug fix. 

1. [Monster Challenge] 'Domimo' unlock condition bug is fixed.

2. Freezing when stage clear and game over occur simultaneously is fixed.

3. Issue that 'Tornado Jiro' keeps spinning at same position is fixed.

4. [High Scoreboard] Function for preventing ranking score falsification is added.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340640/__2/

notes.title: Patch note(April 17 2025)
notes.notes:
This patch includes bug fix and play enhancement.
Please check SNOW BROS. 2 Special patch note.

1. All the buff are initialized when 3-2 stage space shuttle is cleared. Fixed
2. Logic regarding stage clear is enhanced
3. Problem with Monster position. Fixed
4. Network error messages are subdivided
5. Score bonus according to difficulty is added(Record input)
6. Skip timing of endling is modified
7. Logic of Solar Chariot Phase 1 battle is enhanced
8. Intermittent game crash when trophy is gained. Fixed
9. In game UI position is modified
10. EXIT button is added at Title screen
11. Controller button display is modified(XBOX official controller)
12. Specific monsters & characters cannot be unlocked. Fixed
  - Sumoman, Attsu the Great King, Ouch Wall, Solare, Flameslime, Paromo’s Nest, Princess Pudding
13. Other bugs are fixed

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340640/__2/
